propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate requires plan-review attestations to be signed by a pinned environment, but no unpinned developer environment is in the keyring, making the criterion unsatisfiable for any contributor who locally reviews a large bug fix.

The op-cert service accepts plan-review attestation requests but has no client in the repo and cannot persist signatures, so there is no executable path for a developer to obtain a prod-attested certification.
An affirmative 'mismatch' verdict is returned when the DSSE principal is not in trusted_environments.yaml, which flags and blocks changes even when a valid plan review was completed and signed.

The fix removes the cross-host source-of-certification chain (trusted_env_keyring lookup and verify_opcert call) and gates only on the fact of a completed, lifecycle-valid, subject-bound plan-review attestation.

Subject binding (ticket id and kind from the signed payload) is re-asserted as an explicit step after removing verify_opcert, preventing cross-ticket attestation replay while accepting unpinned signing environments.
